name: Relay: pump, valve or light
summary: Switch a pump, valve, fan or light through a relay module, run it for a set time, and a safety limit stops it running forever if something fails.
parts: 12 V pump or solenoid valve and its own power supply
use: Relay pump(7, true, 60000UL); setup: pump.begin(); loop: pump.update(); pump.runFor(10000);

points.note: Call this every loop: it switches off when the run time is over, or when the safety limit is reached.
Cheap relay modules switch ON when the pin is LOW. This flips the signal so on() always means on.
